zones.title: Identify by spoken data
zones.body: Plate plus surname or postcode against the CASE account (placeholder rule until question 20 is agreed). A match stores the customer on the session and account, asset, VIN or FIN, plate and dealer on the case; a miss counts an attempt.

panels.title: AR-18 IdentifyCaller
panels.body: For IVR calls (no VIN) and unknown VINs. The data points are a placeholder until the identification rule is agreed (question 20; no document holds it); the rule lives in the mock and this tool, nowhere else. A match also writes account, asset, VIN or FIN, plate and dealer to the case. Attempts are counted on the session; the IdentifyExhausted guard in AR-02 hands off after two.
